corrections.reason: Both the printed glyph (6th-order ር without a bottom-right 3rd-order leg) and Classical Ge'ez morphology (እግር + -ክሙ = እግርክሙ, Luke 10:11) confirm እግርክሙ.
The printed character is clearly three-legged ጠ in the Amharic word በጠላትም (translating Ge'ez ፀላዒ 'enemy').
The printed line ends with a single four-dot full stop (።), not a doubled one.
